title: Oven Smoked Norwegian Fish Poke
description: A Norwegian dish featuring smoked fish, fish sauce, and nam pla, served raw and cold, with a grassy and pillowy texture. This dish is perfect for those who enjoy raw fish and bold flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place a wire rack on top.
Place the salmon fillets on the wire rack and smoke in the oven for 2 hours.
In a large bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, nam pla, soy sauce, brown sugar, and smoked paprika.
Once the salmon is smoked, let it cool to room temperature.
Cut the smoked salmon into small pieces and add to the bowl with the sauce.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the salmon and toss to coat.
Sprinkle the chopped scallions and toasted sesame seeds over the top of the salmon.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
